title: I built a modern, ad-free web version of 3D Pinball Space Cadet with online leaderboards out of pure nostalgia
author: Ya2ns
selftext:
Hello there ! 

For three years straight, my coworkers and I spent way too many hours at work playing this absolute classic. Out of pure nostalgia and a desire to see how far I could push it, I decided to build a clean, modern web port of it complete with online leaderboards so we could finally settle the scores properly. 

It is a 100 percent free, non-commercial fan tribute to 3D Pinball Space Cadet (along with Dragon's Keep and Skulduggery via DOS emulation from the FullTilt! original game), with zero ads, no tracking, and no monetization. 

You can play right in the browser with keyboard remapping, custom CRT filters, and a few visual themes including a full Windows XP and 95 retro style. 

Down the road, I would love to dig deeper into the source code of the other two tables to integrate them as smoothly as Space Cadet, but that is a massive undertaking. If you end up giving it a spin, I would love to hear your feedback, bug reports, or tips on how to make it better. 

I coded it with gemini's help (i know people prefer claude but i have premium so...)

You can check it out here: webcadet.pages.dev 

I don’t have the money right now to buy a domain but I'll keep you updated ! 

I'm adding features when i'm off work. It’s still a WIP but it’s going great. 

Thanks for the reading !
